summary: Comprehensive testing of Team Features for Business plan. All 22 backend API tests pass (100%). All frontend tabs and components verified working. Team management, shared tasks, shared reminders, team chat, and team analytics all functional.
passed_tests: Business user login (test-stripe@test.com / Test123!) - returns access_token
Free user login (demo@test.com / Test123!) - returns access_token
Unauthenticated access to team endpoints returns 401/403
GET /api/teams/my-team returns team info, membership, and members list
Free user cannot create team (403 - Business plan required)
GET /api/teams/invitations returns pending invitations
POST /api/teams/invite sends invitation (owner/admin only)
GET /api/teams/tasks returns team tasks with enriched member names
POST /api/teams/tasks creates team task with priority and assignee
PUT /api/teams/tasks/{id} updates task (toggle completed)
DELETE /api/teams/tasks/{id} deletes team task
GET /api/teams/reminders returns active team reminders
POST /api/teams/reminders creates team reminder
DELETE /api/teams/reminders/{id} deactivates reminder
GET /api/teams/messages returns team messages in chronological order
POST /api/teams/messages sends team chat message
GET /api/teams/analytics returns stats, member activity, and billing info ($10/seat/mo)
Cannot remove self from team (400)
Role change requires owner permission
Non-team member cannot access tasks (403)
Non-team member cannot access messages (403)
Non-team member cannot access analytics (403)
Team page renders with 5 tabs (Team, Tasks, Reminders, Chat, Analytics)
Team tab shows team name, members table, invite section
Tasks tab shows tasks with priority, completion status, and assignment
Chat tab shows messages and allows sending new ones
Analytics tab shows stat cards, billing info, and member activity table
Free user sees 'No Team Yet' view with 'Business plan required' message
seed_data_creation: Updated demo@test.com password hash and set subscription_plan to 'free' for testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Team Features fully tested (Iteration 9). Existing team 'Letsm Team' owned by test-stripe@test.com with 1 active member and 1 pending invitation. Team has 5 tasks (3 completed), 3 active reminders, and 4 chat messages. All 17 team API endpoints working correctly. Frontend Team page has 5 tabs all functional. Business plan check enforced - free users get 403 when trying to create team. Per-seat billing at $10/seat/mo displayed in Analytics tab.

team_management.details: Create team (business only), invite members, remove members, change roles (owner only)

shared_reminders.details: Create/delete reminders with datetime, shows creator name

team_chat.details: Send/receive messages, chronological order, user attribution

team_analytics.details: Stats (tasks, reminders, messages), billing info ($10/seat/mo), member activity table
